page.content:
Inherited power that turns Mishima blood into Devil.

How Devil Gene connects

  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Kazuya's Devil form is the first great expression of the Devil Gene.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin inherited the Devil Gene from Kazuya and Jun's line.
  • Topic: Tekken — The Devil Gene is the curse that drives the Mishima saga.

What is Devil Gene?

The Devil Gene is the curse in Kazuya and Jin: wings, lasers, and a voice that Heihachi tried to isolate, harvest, or kill rather than father.

Key threads lead to Kazuya Mishima, Jin Kazama and Tekken.
